faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a1: Resumes are uploaded as PDF files. Job descriptions can be pasted as plain text from any job board.
faq.q2: Will the AI make up experience?
faq.a2: No. The AI is instructed to keep everything truthful and based only on your original resume. If details are missing, it adds placeholders like [Phone Number] for you to fill in.
faq.a3: To keep the service fair for everyone, there is a daily generation limit. If you reach it, simply try again the next day.
faq.q4: How do I use the result?
faq.a4: Copy the generated text into your own resume template, or save it directly as a PDF from the result panel.
